input.command: /tmp/ptb-vbrcavpf/play 'answer' '1. Notes for a friend picking up my save: The Kings Gate quest is done. Meer-Tasi at Bell Station named Teku-Sul Spire as the marked tower. The ghost Sul-Xeeth there said the great gate needs three seal-stones: one in the warden vault of Blackrose Prison, one in the flooded vaults of Gemin, one in the deepest hall of Vorannuhl. I reported to Never-Writes-Twice in Helstrom and became Reel-Ka (Warrior) of the Toh-Reel-Ka, got Reel-Ka Cuirass and Helm, 300 gold, free beds in Archwarden forts. Her orders: take all three stones before the Unbound. 2. Next: fetch the stones, Blackrose first (least dangerous), Vorannuhl worst; markers are on the map. 3. Any order; sneak is my preference.
